steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Switch the event from the default type to a price-based auction and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Give the event a findable title required for publication.
Apply the first offered auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product as the first line item with quantity 10.
Populate the remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Set the first line item's delivery location to the requested plant.
Add exactly two QA test vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Return to the events list to verify the resulting live status.
Confirm the newly published auction is shown as Live.
